verdict.rationale: The only evidence close to bulk work is that the dot can use background agents to handle several things in parallel (dots-docs-8) and delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex (dots-docs-13). Its connected apps let it read and update documents and handle recurring channel or bug-report work (dots-docs-11, dots-docs-15), but nothing explicitly describes applying one operation across many items at once. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation capability (e.g. applying an action across many emails, files, or issues in one request), stated limits or scale, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
